rules: Score exact forecast_open_ns+300s only after forecast completed_at
Require actual close present in a copied saved candle snapshot and completed by both snapshot clock and audit clock
No gap interpolation, no next-row substitution, no future actuals
CLOSE-only finite-positive validity is independent of malformed OHLC/volume path validity
q10/q90 empirical coverage is descriptive and uncalibrated; overlapping forecasts are dependent
Percentage errors normalized by the last input close; flat baseline predicts that same close
